from client import save

class MemoryTransport:
    def put(self, path, body):
        self.request = (path, body)
        return {\"ok\": True}

cases = [
    ('  Ada  ', 'Ada'),
    ('Ada Lovelace', 'Ada Lovelace'),
    ('', ''),
    (' \\t\\n ', ''),
    ('\\tAda\\n', 'Ada'),
    ('\\u00a0Ada\\u00a0', 'Ada'),
]
for supplied, expected in cases:
    transport = MemoryTransport()
    result = save(transport, supplied)
    assert result == {'ok': True}
    assert transport.request == ('/settings', {'display_name': expected})
print(f'{len(cases)} public-client boundary probes passed with an in-memory transport')
